context:
Goal: no paused guard step sits for ever with no decision.
Problem (rule): you picked to keep all seven paused until their branch was read; it is read, so each step now needs your keep, drop or fold.
Based on (read): the consultant's read of the seven steps: none is named on main or in any commit message, no incident is recorded for any of them, and the open-pull-request state is unread.
Based on (read): per step, from the consultant. (1) brief-ruling-has-source (a brief's ruling names where it came from): not on main. (2) hold-zero-tests-fails (a test run that finds zero tests fails): partly on main, since the verdict command (the script that runs a check and prints pass or fail) fails a run of zero Swift tests; the same case for Python unittest runs is an open debt (a recorded known gap: a unittest run that reports zero tests passes). (3) lane-default-checks-rulings (a lane checks the rulings before it starts): not on main. (4) review-model-from-agent-record (a reviewer's model is read from the agent's record): main reads the spawn, not the record. (5) scratch-probe-cleanup (scratch probe files are cleaned up): not on main. (6) shared-tree-guard-reads-last-cd (the shared-folder guard reads the last directory change): main may already hold it, since the shared guard code already reads the last directory change in a command; its incident is needed to confirm. (7) silent-undo-reads-octopus (the silent-undo check reads multi-parent merges): a recorded decision (octopus-push-refused) already refuses a push that holds a merge of three or more branches, which is the shape this step would read.
Departs from: main — the seven steps stay paused with no ruling; each is kept, folded or dropped on your answer.
Waiting on: nothing is stopped; the consultant files each outcome.
